serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: I’m an unsociable person, I don’t even have social media accounts. I’m afraid I didn’t hear anything about this whole matter.
Policeman: Unocia- unsocialably? What was the word?
Policewoman: Unsociable…
Policeman: Wasn’t it mentioned in that ’MO’ thing feds send us?
Policewoman: Yes, but don’t speak about it in front of civilians, please…
Policeman: Isn’t that guy also extremely white? Witnesses told us something about it too. We actually might be onto-
Policewoman: Stop right there.
Policewoman: I’m really sorry sir! It’s time for us to go. Thank you for your cooperation!
Policeman: Finally we are done here. Let’s hit some fast food. I want a cheeseburger!
